items.text: Omosomba bw’Omonene nere Omobaso na Omotooria bw’abaanto b’ebisaku bionsi
na ase chinse chionsi chire aare,
Omonene nigo andangeretie konde ase enda ya baba,
nigo andogete erieta konde enda ime.
Agatieria omonwa one okaba buna omoro omwoge,
akambisa ime ase ekiriri gi’okoboko kwaye;
agansoyia ase omobirangwa ime, akambisa aroro.
Korende ngateeba: “Nabeire ngokora emeremo emekong’u bosa,
natugutire chinguru chiane bosa, ntanyoreti gento kende;
nonya naboigo, ekeene, oboronge bwane nigo bokorwa ase Omonene,
na eng’eria yane nigo ekorwa ase Nyasae one.”
Nateebigwe ring’ana n’Omonene, oria ontongete ase enda ya baba
erinde ng’iranie ororeeria rwa Yakobo gochia asare,
Inche nanyorire amasikani ase obosio bw’Omonene,
Nigo agoteeba iga: “Ayio tagoisana asore obe omosomba one
ase okoiraneria ab’ebisaku bia Yakobo amaya abo,
Boigo ningokore obe omobaso bw’abaanto b’ebisaku;
erinde ogotooreka kwane kogende goike ase chinsinyo chi’ense.”
Aya naro Omobooria bw’Abaisraeli, Omochenu obo,
oria ochayetwe kegima na kogechwa na Mwanyabaanto;
oyio ore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli, oyio ogochorire.”
nabeire nkorendete, na goetera asore nakorire okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabaanto,
erinde oiranerie ense amaya aye na gwatanana emiando yasaretigwe.
Otebie abasibwa: Soka korwa ase obosibwa,
na oteebie abare ase omosunte: Eorokie!
Barabwo mbabe bakoragerigwa ekero bare ase orogendo,
mbanyore oborisia bwabo ase ebigoro na ase ebitunwa biarenge bosa.
ekiagera Omonene oria obaroreire amaabera nabaraae,
ne chinchera chiane chinene nchiroisigwe chiimokerere igoro.
Rora, abanto mbache korwa chinse chi’aare,
abande barue sugusu, na abande bosongo,
na abande barue ense ya Sinimu.”
Korende abanto ba Sayoni nigo bagoteeba:
Rora, nigo imang’erete amarieta aino ase ebisanyi bi’amaboko aane;
na abagosaretie nigo bagotama korwa asore.
Omonene oteebire ng’a ekeene, buna Ere are moyo,
abwo bonsi babe buna ogwechabera kwao,
“Ekeene, ense eyio yaino yasaretigwe kegima, egatigwa bosa,
abanto abwo baabakorerete bobe batamire gochia aare mono.
Nebe ase engaki eyio abana kwauretwe
Erio nokwane ase enkoro yao, bweborie:
“Rora, nindambore okoboko kwane gochia ase abanto b’ebisaku,
erio abanto abwo mbarente abana bao abamura, baababeegete bikuba,
na abana bao abaiseke baababeegete mareko.”
Abwo mbatung’ame inse, baumame ase obosio bwao,
Erio nonyare komanya ng’a ninche Omonene;
Inee! Omonto ore ne chinguru naurwe egiasakoire?
Gose oyore noboronge naurwe abasibwa baye?
Abanto abwo bakogochanda nimbabetererie barie chinyama chi’emebere yabo abanyene,
Erio abanto bonsi mbamanye ng’a ninche Omonene inde Omotooria oo,
na Omobooria oo, Omobui o Yakobo.”
